name: esp32c6
title: Espressif ESP32-C6 as a radio

facts.source: the C6 of the JC1060P470C on SDIO, esp_hosted 3.0.9 and 3.0.10

firmware.source: esp_hosted_get_coprocessor_fwversion and esp_hosted_slave_ota_* from the P4 of the JC1060P470C: 3.0.9 to 3.0.10 and back

notes: The radio of a chip without one, as the ESP32-P4: Wi-Fi and Bluetooth LE over SDIO, SPI or UART, by esp_hosted on both sides. The host and the C6 run the same version of esp_hosted.

firmware set by program: the component keeps the firmware of the C6 at the esp_hosted of the program's build, by the flash step of the build. A board whose C6 runs a firmware of its own says set tool (or factory), and the component does not change it.
